response.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT zoneref, SUM(traitcount) AS cnt FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref), t AS (SELECT s.zoneref, s.cnt, s.cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM s) AS share, 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT zoneref AS site_code, cnt AS feature_count, share, share - avg_share AS margin_above_average FROM t WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC LIMIT 10
